answers.text: Blocking criteria are listed for the trustees
answers.evidence: The reply describes in plain words every G2 criterion that has findings and blocks L1. These match the five SCs marked fail in the report's WCAG table (1.4.3, 1.4.11, 2.4.7, 2.5.8, 3.3.8), and both examples are covered: 'Paste blocked: you can't paste into the password field' (3.3.8, A11Y-14, F-0012) and 'No focus highlight: the sign-up form shows no highlight on the field you're in' (2.4.7, A11Y-04, F-0011). It also covers faint text ('2.5:1 against a required 4.5:1', A11Y-01/A11Y-11), faint field borders ('1.4:1 against a required 3:1', A11Y-12) and small buttons ('20 px; the minimum is 24 px', A11Y-01). It presents these as the reason 'The flow didn't reach any level yet', in content meant for the trustees ('Strengths to mention honestly'). The report's verdict also names A11Y-01 and A11Y-04 under 'Blocking L1'. Caveat: the reply does not name every G2 blocker that is blocking only because its check did not run (targets, forms, live-regions, lang, cross-page). Among the checks that did not run, it names only 'dialogs', plus '31 are still unchecked'. The how's examples are both failing criteria, so this gap does not change the verdict.
